Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: FAR BACKGROUND layer for a 2D side-scrolling BMX game.
Reference image: use the attached painted beach ONLY as a painting-style reference (soft hand-painted brush texture, clean colors, soft shading, atmospheric depth, no dark outlines). Do not reproduce its tropical palms, foreground beach objects, huts or sunset.
Create ONE VERY WIDE 32:9 seamless horizontal panorama, ideally 3840 x 1080 pixels, equivalent to two 16:9 screens side by side. The composition is a continuous side-view landscape with no central perspective vanishing point.
Place: the restinga of Costa WinnerZ, a fictional sunny Brazilian coastal town: low wind-shaped coastal scrub in subdued olive and sage greens, broad rounded pale ochre sand dunes, a thin distant blue strip of sea behind the dunes, a few low broad-canopied cashew trees. Two or three TINY hazy house silhouettes far on the horizon, unobtrusive and small, whose windows can be lit in a later night version.
DAYTIME, hot summer: pale yellowish light-blue sky, subtle heat haze, a strong small white-yellow sun high in the sky, very soft sparse wispy clouds. The landscape is distant, hazy and LOW CONTRAST, softer and lighter than gameplay objects. Neutral bright warm sunlight, no sunset orange wash.
Composition: upper half mostly open sky; distant sea/horizon around 50–55% height; low dunes and scrub between about 55% and 70% height. The entire bottom 30% must be EMPTY, QUIET, ALMOST FLAT SAND COLOR with only barely perceptible soft brush grain; no vegetation, stones, houses, tracks or objects there because the game will cover it.
SEAMLESS HORIZONTAL TILING IS ESSENTIAL: the left and right vertical edges must meet with the same sky, horizon, sea level, dune contours and colors. Keep the outermost 10% of both sides low-detail and open, with matching flat horizon and low scrub/terrain heights; keep all trees and houses away from both edges. No visible seam when copies are placed side by side.
Hand-painted cartoon background, beautiful soft brushwork matching the reference, clean saturated but hazy colors, soft shading, no outlines around scenery.
No text, no letters, no logos, no numbers, no watermark, no people, no characters, no bikes, no track surface in foreground.
